Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Try malformed headers with embedded NULs and long lines
cases=[b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\x00AAAA', b'@SQ\tSN:A\tLN:1\n@SQ\tSN:B\tLN:2\x00', b'@SQ\tSN:'+b'A'*300+b'\tLN:1\n']
for i,c in enumerate(cases):
    Path(f'/tmp/nul{i}').write_bytes(c)
    print(i, len(c))
PY
cd /workspace && for f in /tmp/nul0 /tmp/nul1 /tmp/nul2; do echo "== $f =="; bash submit.sh "$f" /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true; done
